_readme: Parity registry (AGENTS.md "Parity"; kitbag.py parity, lint PARITY). adapters.<family>: config key, code file, verbs, caps (Test-KitCap), built-in names, vendor names; fallback.<verb> = what the kit does instead, same outcome (an optional verb); gaps."<name>[,<name>]/<verb>[,<verb>]" = what does not work there and why (kitbag.py parity next lists it to close; a gap the tool cannot close: "no such feature: <its doc link> <why>"); accepted."<name>/<verb>" = a fallback that is the design, with its reason (out of parity next); capKeys.<cap> = the keys that turn it on; parity = why a family is not walked. harness: hooks (settings.json hook -> the port's command, else "gap: <why>" | "fallback: <how>"), features (Claude Code-only features, the same values).

adapters._readme: README Adapters; code: Register-KitAdapter <kind> <name> @{ <verb> = {...} } (ps1) or ADAPTERS['<kind>']['<name>'] = {...} (py)

tracker.verbs: view url status comment comments create describe rename list owner
tracker.caps: checklist commentEdit commentDelete statuses move attach dependencies labels
tracker.vendors: clickup github gitlab jira jira-server linear youtrack azure

fallback.checklist: an Items block in the description (<!-- kit:<name> -->): a markdown task list, the tool's own checklist form where it has no checklist API (Linear, YouTrack: a checklist lives in the description)
fallback.dependencies: a **Waits on:** line in the description

gaps.linear/checklist: no such feature: https://linear.app/docs/parent-and-sub-issues an issue has sub-issues, no checklist entity; a checklist is description markdown, which the Items block is (fallback = Linear's own form)
gaps.youtrack/checklist: no such feature: https://www.jetbrains.com/help/youtrack/devportal/resource-api-issues.html the issue API has no checklist field; checklists are description markdown (https://www.jetbrains.com/help/youtrack/cloud/youtrack-markdown-syntax-issues.html#checklists), which the Items block is (fallback = YouTrack's own form)
gaps.jira-server/checklist: no such feature: https://docs.atlassian.com/software/jira/docs/api/REST/9.17.0/ Jira Data Center REST has no checklist resource, only sub-tasks (Marketplace apps add one); the Items block stands
gaps.jira/checklist: no such feature: https://developer.atlassian.com/platform/framework/adf-builder/reference/nodes/taskList/ ADF taskList is not supported in Jira issue fields (Marketplace apps only); the Items block stands

fallback.mr.labels: a Tags: line in the MR body (devtools.py mr_labels)

gaps.bitbucket/mr.labels: no such feature: https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/bitbucket/rest/api-group-pullrequests/ Bitbucket Cloud pull requests have no labels; the Tags: body line (fallback) stands

ci.verbs: runs jobs log status config failure parseUrl
ci.vendors: github gitlab bitbucket azure gitea jenkins

gaps.none/agentMeta: no transcript (another tool): no agent to look up; board and journal only

deploy-kind.names: command ci-job branch-mr ssh tag probe manual awsStack laneApk

fallback.lastDeploy: the kit's deploy log (bossy.ps1 deploy run / record) of the target: the deploy board's last time (manual, probe: a person deploys, no system records it)
fallback.deploy: the row's command.deploy line ({sha} {repo} {mr}; bossy.ps1 deploy run), else UNSUPPORTED: a person deploys, then bossy.ps1 deploy record (probe: it only reads the live commit)
fallback.isRunning: a bossy.ps1 deploy run of the target in flight (deploys/running-<target>.json, its process alive: deploys.ps1 Test-KitDeployRunning; manual, probe: no system to ask; laneApk: the build runs inside deploy run)
fallback.restart: the row's command.restart line ({service}), else its ssh block (host, manager or restartCmd), else bossy.ps1 deploy restart refuses naming them (a kind is the delivery path, not the runtime: the row says how its service restarts)

accepted.probe/deploy: a probe only reads the live commit: no delivery path of its own (command.deploy or a person)
accepted.branch-mr,ci-job,tag,manual,probe/restar: a kind is the delivery path, not the runtime: the row's command.restart or ssh block says how its service restarts
accepted.manual,probe/lastDeploy: a person deploys and no system records it: the kit's deploy log (deploy record) is the record
accepted.manual,probe/isRunning: a person deploys: no system to ask; a kit deploy run's marker covers the runs the kit makes
accepted.laneApk/isRunning: the build runs inside bossy.ps1 deploy run (phoney.ps1 build, no remote pipeline): its running marker is the whole truth

gaps.env/write,set,delete,rotate: no such feature: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/procthread/environment-variables a process changes only its own environment and its children's, never the owner's shell or CI that set it (UNSUPPORTED names it; a written file would be a second store: use file or keychain)

process-gate.parity: a built-in is one rule for its own gates (testingDocs: promote here, finish / merge / mrBody in devtools.py; reproRow: bugFix in devtools.py); an unset gate passes

db-engine.caps: marks temp sizes kill snap revert unsnap
db-engine.vendors: mysql mariadb postgres sqlserver sqlite oracle mongodb redis elasticsearch opensearch

fallback.query: the engine's sql verb when the env sets no db.query line (envy.ps1 Invoke-Hook query)
fallback.snap: none needed: the position (a binlog file:offset, an SCN) is the mark, zero bytes
fallback.unsnap: none needed: a position mark holds no snapshot

gaps.mysql,mariadb/snap,unsnap: no such feature: https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.0/en/point-in-time-recovery.html no per-schema snapshot on a live server (a clone or dump is a full copy, never made by the kit): the binlog position is the mark and the binlog the undo (revert: db_flashback.py), nothing to make or drop
gaps.oracle/snap,unsnap: no such feature: https://docs.oracle.com/en/database/oracle/oracle-database/19/sqlrf/CREATE-RESTORE-POINT.html a normal restore point only names an SCN (the mark already is one) and a guaranteed one covers the whole database with flashback logging and DBA rights: nothing per schema to make or drop
gaps.oracle/binlogs: no such feature: https://docs.oracle.com/en/database/oracle/oracle-database/19/admin/managing-undo.html undo_retention is a target, not a list of restorable SCNs: no expiry list; a mark past it fails the FLASHBACK TABLE revert, which says so
gaps.oracle/query: no such feature: https://docs.oracle.com/en/database/oracle/oracle-database/19/sqpug/ SQL*Plus reads statements from a script or stdin only, no one-line option (and CONNECT on argv would show the password): the sql verb runs it over stdin
gaps.redis/sql: no such feature: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/ commands on keys, no statement language with rows: Invoke-DbSql refuses (db.schemasQuery, tenants column model); envy.ps1 sql runs the query preset (raw commands)
gaps.redis/jdbc: no such feature: https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/ Redis clients speak RESP, no JDBC driver or SQL: an app takes the env's redis URL from its own config
gaps.postgres/marks,pos,binlogs,snap,revert,u: no such feature: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/continuous-archiving.html point-in-time recovery replays WAL into a whole cluster from a base backup with the server stopped; no per-database restore point on a live server (a TEMPLATE copy is a full copy, never made by the kit): restore by seed
gaps.mongodb/marks,pos,binlogs,snap,revert,un: no such feature: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/backups/ point-in-time restore needs Atlas / Ops Manager backup; the server alone has mongodump (a full dump, never made by the kit): restore by seed
gaps.redis/marks,pos,binlogs,snap,revert,unsn: no such feature: https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/oss_and_stack/management/persistence/ an RDB snapshot covers the whole instance and loads only at server start: no restore on a live server; restore by seed
gaps.sqlite/temp,kill: no such feature: https://www.sqlite.org/serverless.html an embedded engine: no server connections to measure or end; the db file is the whole store (the storage guard sizes it)
gaps.mongodb/temp,kill: no such feature: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/currentOp/ currentOp reports no per-operation temp disk (allowDiskUse spills are not counted per op): maxTimeMS bounds a query
gaps.redis/temp,kill: no such feature: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/client-list/ an in-memory store: no temp disk per connection (CLIENT LIST shows memory only)
gaps.elasticsearch,opensearch/temp,kill: no such feature: https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/elasticsearch/reference/current/tasks.html tasks report no per-search temp disk; search memory is bounded by circuit breakers

gaps.none/list,drop,import,footprint: no tenants (tenants.model none): each tenant verb refuses, naming the models to set; every other verb works on the db scope

fallback.import: the env's seed (envy.ps1 seed: the tenant's rows as seed items) or the app's own tenant import (column: rows share tables with every tenant; instance: the tenant's server is an env of its own)
fallback.drop: instance: the tenant's server is an env of its own (envy.ps1 teardown / down there)
fallback.footprint: instance: the tenant's server is an env of its own (envy.ps1 sql -Query schemaSizes there)

accepted.instance/drop,import,footprint: each tenant is an env of its own: envy.ps1 on that env (teardown, seed, sql schemaSizes) is the native path
accepted.column/import: rows share tables with every tenant: an import risks id clashes and large writes (AGENTS.md "No large writes"); the env's seed or the app's own import

migration.verbs: check discover pendingSql tag rollback resetEdited missingRoutines rerunRoutines historyScopes

device.verbs: dump tap tapid tapxy type clear key swipe openurl shot shotmark wait photo log mic

gaps.ios/photo,mic: no such feature: https://developer.apple.com/documentation/xcode/testing-in-simulator-versus-testing-on-hardware-devices a Simulator has no camera and no audio injection: pokey.ps1 ui refuses, naming the ios actions; prove it on an android lane or by hand
gaps.none/dump,tap,tapid,tapxy,type,clear,key: no device lanes (devices.type none): app checks are NOT_TESTED

harness._readme: kitbag.py port writes the Codex (.codex/) and Antigravity (.agents/) copies; a hook not listed runs the same script verb there

PreToolUse bossy.ps1 guard-sendmessage.codex: fallback: no SendMessage hook; AGENTS.md Crew rule: crew messages only through bossy.ps1 board msg
PreToolUse bossy.ps1 guard-sendmessage.antigravity: fallback: no SendMessage hook; AGENTS.md Crew rule: crew messages only through bossy.ps1 board msg

PostToolUse ctx_hook.mjs.codex: fallback: board beat prints the CONTEXT-CHECK line
PostToolUse ctx_hook.mjs.antigravity: fallback: board beat prints the CONTEXT-CHECK line

guard on file reads and MCP SQL.codex: port: PreToolUse guard_client.mjs on Bash|apply_patch|mcp__*(sql|query)* (Codex reads files through its shell; hook input tool_name / tool_input as Claude Code)
guard on file reads and MCP SQL.antigravity: port: PreToolUse guard_client.mjs on view_file|call_mcp_tool|mcp_.* (https://antigravity.google/docs/hooks/: Read caps, the logins file, SQL row caps; answered { decision, reason })

test-login read deny.codex: fallback: kit.rules exec policy + the shell guard (best-effort)
test-login read deny.antigravity: port: guard_client.mjs denies view_file of the logins file, an always-on rule, the shell guard

per-agent tool and MCP lists.codex: gap: no such feature: https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/agent-configuration/subagents a custom agent has no tools allow-list and its mcp_servers / sandbox_mode do not override the parent: the ported note names the allowlist, the guard covers both
per-agent tool and MCP lists.antigravity: port: tools: [<agy names>] in .agents/agents/*.md (https://antigravity.google/docs/subagents/; kitbag_ports.py GRAVITY_TOOL_MAP + call_mcp_tool); an agent with a tool agy cannot name (WebFetch, WebSearch) keeps all tools

Artifacts.codex: fallback: the HTML file itself (supervise-report.html, a report artifact under <runtime>), opened in a browser; the Codex CLI has no viewer (https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/artifacts-viewer)
Artifacts.antigravity: fallback: the HTML file itself (supervise-report.html, a report artifact under <runtime>), opened in a browser; agy Artifacts are its own plans and walkthroughs (https://antigravity.google/docs/artifacts/)

blocking owner questions.codex: fallback: request_user_input in Plan mode, else bossy.ps1 decide ask (blocking)
blocking owner questions.antigravity: fallback: ask_question when listed, else bossy.ps1 decide ask

run journals (Runs band, stuck checks, r.codex: fallback: the .codex/workflows procedure journals each step (kitbag.py port --journal) into <runtime>/work/port-runs/codex/

Monitor and background-shell check.codex: port: the shell sweep finds shells under codex by their exec_command in the rollout (supervise-resources.ps1 KitShellCall)
Monitor and background-shell check.antigravity: port: the shell sweep finds shells under agy by their run_command in transcript.jsonl (supervise-resources.ps1 KitShellCall)
